chasing.workspaceText: I’m trying to understand what makes someone truly good at what they do — not just technically skilled, but capable of taking a difficult problem and actually doing something meaningful with it
paragraphs: I’m trying to understand what makes someone truly impactful — not just successful, but capable of taking a difficult problem and turning it into something meaningful. The more I learn, build, and experiment, the more I realize that the people I admire most are not trying to do everything. They are <mark>working deeply on problems that actually matter</mark>, learning whatever they need along the way, and building things that create real value.

Overall, it comes down to one thing I want to build in myself: <mark>Excellence</mark>. Not being perfect, not knowing everything, and not being the smartest person in the room — but constantly raising the standard of what I can do.

I’m still early in that journey, and there is a lot I don’t know yet. But I don’t want to be afraid of that. I want to keep learning, keep taking on harder problems, and keep putting myself in situations where I have to grow. <mark>Excellence and learning are a lifelong journey</mark>. I want to spend my life becoming better at understanding problems, building useful things, and creating an impact that goes beyond myself. <mark>Will keep learning. Will keep building. Will keep DOING.</mark>
